subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR require redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the credential gap for this narrow header-only fix?
rationale: The source fix and regression test are convincing, but the reported failure depends on live Z.AI edge behavior and the contributor says they do not have a Coding Plan key for after-fix proof.

options.title: Require live endpoint-detection proof
options.body: Merge only after the contributor or a maintainer supplies redacted live output, logs, or a terminal screenshot showing the patched flow selecting the Coding Plan endpoint.

options.title: Accept the credential gap
options.body: Maintainers may choose to merge based on the issue's live before-fix output plus the narrow source/test evidence, while documenting that no after-fix service smoke was available.

recommendation.title: Require live endpoint-detection proof
recommendation.body: Merge only after the contributor or a maintainer supplies redacted live output, logs, or a terminal screenshot showing the patched flow selecting the Coding Plan endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available owner signal is prior Z.AI detection/onboarding feature history in the touched files.
